title: SFC Circular on Tokenisation of SFC-authorised Investment Products (23EC53)
summary: Sets out conditions for tokenising SFC-authorised investment products for public offering in Hong Kong, including safeguards on token ownership records, smart contract integrity, cybersecurity and disclosure.
notes: Defines requirements for tokenisation arrangements for publicly offered SFC-authorised products, including expectations on record-keeping and technology risk.

title: SFC Circular on Intermediaries Engaging in Tokenised Securities-related Activities (23EC52)
summary: Provides guidance to intermediaries on dealing in, advising on, and managing tokenised securities and funds investing in tokenised securities, applying a 'same business, same risks, same rules' approach.
notes: Clarifies that existing securities regulations apply equally to tokenised securities, with additional focus on DLT, token ownership, and technology risks.

title: HKMA Project Ensemble Sandbox – Asset Tokenisation Use Case Platform
summary: Describes the launch of the Project Ensemble sandbox for interbank settlement of tokenised assets using experimental tokenised money, covering fixed income, funds, green finance and trade-related assets.
notes: Key HKMA communication for asset tokenisation sandbox arrangements and PvP/DvP mechanisms involving tokenised deposits.

title: MAS – First Industry Pilot for Digital Asset and DeFi Goes Live (Project Guardian)
summary: Announces the first Project Guardian industry pilot using tokenised government bonds and deposits to test DeFi applications in wholesale funding markets.
notes: Foundational MAS communication on Project Guardian tokenisation pilot scope and participants.

title: MAS – Partners Financial Industry to Expand Asset Tokenisation Initiatives (Project Guardian)
summary: Sets out an expanded set of Project Guardian pilots across tokenised funds, bonds and bank liabilities, involving multiple international financial institutions.
notes: Core MAS release defining the broader tokenisation roadmap and pilot stream structure under Project Guardian.

title: MAS – Plans to Support Commercialisation of Asset Tokenisation
summary: Outlines MAS' strategy to move asset tokenisation from pilot to commercial scale, including liquidity, interoperability and tokenised fund initiatives.
notes: Anchors the transition from experimentation to commercialisation for tokenised assets in Singapore.
